title: Review: jmap-mail-server pass 6 changes
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — two correctness gaps: Email/set create silently accepts malformed keywords (inconsistency with Email/import), and Mailbox/query + EmailSubmission/query silently coerce invalid limit (inconsistency with Email/query). The MailboxFilterCondition/handler disconnect is a public API design issue that will confuse implementors.
Confidence: 90% no missed bugs. Least confident: email.rs build_email_from_create — the serde-based keyword parsing could have other silent swallows for malformed but parsable input. Uncertainty driven by: no integration tests exercise malformed keyword paths in Email/set create.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — the limit always-Some issue is the main type-level confusion. No unsafe, no gratuitous clones, no unwrap in library code. The vacation.rs map_err on infallible serialize is verbose but follows the crate convention.
Pass 7 review: no new findings at P0-P2. Pass 7 changes are clean. Loop converged — both passes produce only P3/opinion findings. Confidence: 95%+ no missed bug. Remaining uncertainty: no test for Mailbox/query filter logic via MailboxFilterCondition fields (parentId/name/role), but this was also untested before the refactor.
